sources.title: Official Release of Seed1.8: A Generalized Agentic Model
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact launch describes a new generalized agentic model, optimized image encoding and thinking modes, but gives no nominal total or active count and does not identify a publicly sized base. Existing December 18 release and Doubao1.8 mapping evidence is unchanged.

sources.title: Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full 48-page official PDF text freshly retrieved October 27. The introduction describes unified perception/reasoning/action; section 2.4 compares inference-token efficiency with Seed1.6, not shared weights or a size-preserving base relationship. Parameter mentions concern example task files. No nominal total, active count or activated-parameter comparison table is published.

sources.title: ByteDance-Seed-1.8 — BytePlus ModelArk
sources.evidence: Complete indexed primary text identifies seed-1-8-251228, 256k context, 224k maximum input, text/image/video input and text output, deep thinking and function calling. Index was crawled about three months before review; direct retrieval currently exposes only the page shell. Establishes documented specifications, not live endpoint operation.

sources.title: ByteDance-Seed/Seed-1.8 official repository
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The official README, model card link and repository file list provide API cookbooks and describe capabilities. They give neither nominal parameter counts nor a sized-base relationship. No weight release is supplied; the repository license does not establish a model-weight license.

sources.title: Seed Model Portfolio
sources.evidence: Places Seed1.8 in the Seed Model Series and gives December 17, 2025, conflicting with the launch announcement visible December 18 date. HTML hard-codes publishTime 2025-12-17 without a timezone.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the fresh October 27 full 78-page PDF text, including the exact Seed1.8 comparison columns in vision and video tables. Values are benchmark scores, not total or active parameters. The introduction calls Seed1.8 a prior release; no size-bearing lineage or activated-count column was found.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the fresh October 27 full 73-page official PDF text and searched exact-model/count/activation/base terminology. No Seed1.8 nominal total, active count or retrospective sized-base relationship was found. Parameter matches concern programming task examples.

sources.title: BytePlus Service Specific Terms
sources.evidence: Indexed current terms define BytePlus Model Services as provider-owned API services and grant a limited, nontransferable, revocable service license. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for this hosted first-party model; direct retrieval exposes only the shell.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity (June 2026)
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the fresh October 27 full 87-page June report. Exact Seed1.8 comparison columns contain capability scores, not parameter counts. Its references to earlier Seed releases and generic model evolution do not establish weight-sharing lineage; no activated-parameter table for Seed1.8 was found.

sources.title: BytePlus current model list
sources.evidence: Parent read live embedded document. Exact seed-1-8-251228 retiring-model row lists 256K context, 224K input, 64K output including CoT, deep reasoning, multimodal understanding and tool use. Endpoint operation was not tested.

sources.title: Introduction to techniques used in Seed1.6
sources.evidence: Direct web reopen timed out October 27; independently read the same-day fetched official HTML. It discloses 230B total and 23B active for Seed1.6 pretraining and explicitly names Seed1.6-Thinking and Seed1.6 Adaptive CoT post-training variants. It does not identify Seed1.8 as a variant of that base. Those nominal counts cannot be transferred merely from succession.

sources.title: Seed2.0 current model comparison page
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026, including the updated April Lite comparison. The exact Seed1.8 column gives GUI benchmark scores (OSWorld and MobileWorld), with no total or activated-parameter column. No size-bearing lineage for Seed1.8 is stated.

sources.title: Doubao parameter-iteration social post - unverified numeric lead
sources.evidence: Fresh Chinese search indexed a 300–400B total / 30–40B active claim for Doubao1.8. Opening the live post returned no readable body. No primary source for those figures emerged from focused exact-name searches; the indexed social claim is not treated as an inspected specification or verified lineage.

sources.title: AI tools comparison - generic Doubao numeric lead
sources.evidence: Fresh Chinese search surfaced a 1.8T-total/380B-active claim about generic Doubao, without exact Seed1.8 attribution. Direct reopen returned HTTP 403. It is not accepted as model-specific evidence, and no developer source supporting the claim was found.

name.note: Spacing-normalized display name for official Seed1.8 / ByteDance-Seed-1.8.

developer.note: Developed by the ByteDance Seed team.

family.note: Official portfolio places this model in the Seed Model Series.

release_date.note: Month confirmed. Portfolio says December 17; explicit launch announcement says December 18. Its midnight-China timestamp falls on December 17 UTC, making timezone normalization plausible but unproved for the portfolio date. Preserve month precision; 251228 is a later API revision, not first release.

open_weights.note: Reviewed official distribution is a hosted API with cookbook and card; no public model-weight release is supplied by the official repository.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under provider service terms. The cookbook repository Apache-2.0 license is not a model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 original-source, full-card, later-comparison and English/Chinese nominal-size/lineage checks found no developer-published total or explicit link to a publicly sized base. Seed1.6 is an inference-efficiency comparator, not an identified shared checkpoint. The 230B Seed1.6 disclosure names other post-training variants; numeric social/blog leads lack verified exact-model primary support. Null reflects absent supported nominal evidence, not a requirement for a tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently on October 27. Neither the original card nor three later full cards/current comparison tables disclose Seed1.8 activated parameters or an activation convention. Thinking modes change inference-token budgets, not a documented parameter count. No supported relationship allows transferring Seed1.6’s 23B active count, and unsupported numeric leads are not specifications.

architecture.note: Model card establishes vision-language behavior but does not disclose the backbone or dense/MoE structure. Exact-name architecture/training/interpretability searches found no primary disclosure; related-model architectures are not evidence.

context_window.note: Retains the catalog decimal normalization of the provider 256k context label; distinct from 224k maximum input.

modalities.note: Exact international API page explicitly includes video input. Model card independently evaluates video understanding; no audio support is asserted.

reasoning.note: Exact API page and model card document configurable thinking modes.

tool_call.note: Exact API documentation includes function calling and tool-call reasoning; the model card evaluates tool use.

patch.notes: Seed1.8 is documented internationally as ByteDance-Seed-1.8 (seed-1-8-251228); the launch announcement maps it to Volcano Engine Doubao1.8. Public launch is December 2025: official portfolio says December 17, while the launch announcement says December 18 (midnight China / December 17 UTC); exact day is retained as unresolved. API suffix 251228 denotes a later revision. BytePlus indexed documentation includes video input and 256k context; it does not establish current endpoint operation. Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; comparisons with Seed1.6 do not establish a size-preserving base relationship. Backbone architecture remains undisclosed. Apache-2.0 covers the official cookbook repository, not hosted weights.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after fresh launch/repository review, independent inspection of four freshly retrieved cards, later comparison tables and English/Chinese nominal-size and named-base searches. Seed1.6 comparison does not establish shared weights; its 230B/23B counts are not transferred. Numeric social/blog leads lack verified primary support. All unrelated assessments, release-month precision and API qualifications are preserved.
